text:
Sarah (Sales): Hey team — Enterprise prospect wants a 12-month reserved commitment. They expect 8k RPS of small-chat requests during peak windows (10m bursts) and 1k RPS steady. Need a quick presales run on reserved GPU count + autoscale policy. Any initial thoughts?
Olivia (AE): Customer is OK with monthly billing. Main asks: predictable latency (<150ms p95), data residency in eu-west, and fallback behavior if reserved capacity is saturated.
Raj (SolutionsEng): Quick q: what’s avg token/req? Are these chat turns with history?
Sarah (Sales): Mostly short messages, ~40 tokens avg, but with KV cache expect warm path for returning users. 20% of traffic has >200 token context occasionally.
Marta (SRE): For p95 <150ms with 40 tokens at 8k RPS bursts, we need to plan for continuous batching but also KV cache hit rates. If warm KV cache hit ~70% we can save ~35% GPU work.
Alan (Infra): Prefer reserved + burst credits model. I'm thinking baseline reserved to cover steady 1k RPS, plus dedicated pool for burst buffer. Rough calc: one A100-like instance (8x gpus) can handle ~600-800 small-gen RPS depending on model and quantization.
Raj (SolutionsEng): Agreed. If we assume quantized Llama-variant and batching tuned, target per-GPU steady RPS ~150-200. For 1k steady -> 6 GPUs reserved. For 8k bursts -> headroom ~40-50 GPUs during peak. So reserved 8-12 GPUs + burst pool to 48 GPUs.
Sarah (Sales): Pricing asks: customer wants estimate for "reserved 12 GPUs + burst to 48" vs "reserved 24 GPUs and smaller burst". Can SRE comment on cost/latency tradeoff?
Marta (SRE): Tradeoffs: more reserved GPUs reduces cold start risk and queueing during burst. But reserved capacity cost rises linearly. Autoscale policy recommendations:
- reserve 12 GPUs (covers steady + modest ramp)
- burst policy to allow up to 48 GPUs with fast scale-up (90s target)
- prewarm windows for known peak periods (cron-based preheat 5-10m before)
- conservative queue depth limit per-GPU to keep p95 <150ms

Alan (Infra): Also recommend AZ-affinity: split reserved across 2 AZs (60/40) and allow burst to spin up in both AZs for resilience. Add automatic fallback route to smaller-but-faster model variant when capacity constrained.
Olivia (AE): They asked about preheat triggers — can we tie to metrics or schedule?
Raj (SolutionsEng): Both. Preferred pattern: schedule-based preheat for business hours + metric-based trigger on 95th percentile request rate over 30s. Example policy snippet: 
```json
{"autoscale": {"min_gpus": 12, "max_gpus": 48, "scale_up": {"policy": "rps_threshold", "window_secs": 30, "threshold_rps_per_gpu": 180}, "preheat_schedules": [{"cron": "0 8 * * *", "tz": "Europe/London", "preheat_secs": 600}]}}
```
Sarah (Sales): Nice. Can we provide a one-pager cost delta for reserved 12 vs reserved 24? They want to see unit economics before committing.
Marta (SRE): I'll run numbers tonight using our perf profs (quantized model, 40 token avg). Need to confirm expected KV hit.
Sarah (Sales): I'll ask the customer to confirm KV cache hit estimate and percent of long-context requests.
Olivia (AE): Also attach security questionnaire note: they require audit logs and KMS integration for Private deployment. That might shift them to Private or Dedicated.
Alan (Infra): Dedicated reserved cluster supports customer-managed KMS in VPC. That’s a different pricing bucket. Flagging for finance.
Marta (SRE): One more note: preheat should warm KV and model weights separately. KV warm is faster, model weight loading can take longer on certain nodes — use rolling prewarm to avoid AZ-wide load.
Raj (SolutionsEng): I'll draft a short runbook & pricing scenarios. Assigning owners: Marta -> perf numbers + cost delta; Raj -> runbook and autoscale policy; Sarah/Olivia -> confirm customer KV/traffic profile + legal questionnaire.
Sarah (Sales): Thanks — tagging @Raj (SolutionsEng) and @Marta (SRE) to follow up.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: capacity-sim-run for "quantized-small-chat" started (job id: cap-sim-3123).
Marta (SRE): Got the sim output: with 70% KV hit our recommended sizing yields ~p95 140ms at 8k burst with reserved 12 + burst to 48. Cost delta estimates: reserved12 = baseline X, reserved24 = ~1.9x baseline. I'll add concrete $ numbers in the doc.
Olivia (AE): Perfect — customer meeting Thursday, can we have slides & numbers by Wednesday EOD?
Sarah (Sales): Yes. Raj/Marta can we target Wed EOD?
Raj (SolutionsEng): Yes — I'll put the runbook PR and policy snippet in the sales doc.
Marta (SRE): I'll drop the perf table + CSV and add notes about preheat windows.
Sarah (Sales): Great work team :thumbsup:
Olivia (AE): Thanks all — will update the customer after Wed.
